findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
findings.description: The Content-Security-Policy response header restricts the sources of scripts, images, and other assets, mitigating Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.
findings.remediation: Define and deploy a restrictive Content-Security-Policy header (e.g., default-src 'self').
findings.evidence: Header 'Content-Security-Policy' was not returned in HTTP 200 response.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
findings.description: HSTS instructs modern browsers to only connect to the domain using HTTPS, preventing SSL-stripping attacks and man-in-the-middle downgrade attempts.
findings.remediation: Add 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload' to all HTTPS responses.
findings.evidence: Header 'Strict-Transport-Security' was not returned in HTTP 200 response.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header (Clickjacking)
findings.description: Without X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors, the application may be embedded in an attacker's iframe, exposing users to clickjacking.
findings.remediation: Send 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or 'X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN', or use CSP 'frame-ancestors' directive.
findings.evidence: Header 'X-Frame-Options' was not returned in HTTP 200 response.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options Header
findings.description: Without 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff', browsers may attempt to MIME-sniff the response content, potentially executing untrusted uploads as HTML/JavaScript.
findings.remediation: Set 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' across all HTTP responses.
findings.evidence: Header 'X-Content-Type-Options' was not returned in HTTP 200 response.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings.description: A missing Referrer-Policy may cause browsers to leak sensitive path or query parameters in the Referer header when navigating to external origins.
findings.evidence: Header 'Referrer-Policy' was not returned in HTTP 200 response.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy Header
findings.description: Permissions-Policy allows site administrators to disable or restrict browser features such as geolocation, camera, microphone, and payment APIs.
findings.remediation: Implement a Permissions-Policy header restricting unused browser hardware and APIs.
findings.evidence: Header 'Permissions-Policy' was not returned in HTTP 200 response.

findings.title: Missing Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy (COOP)
findings.description: COOP ensures top-level documents do not share a browsing context group with cross-origin documents, protecting against Spectre-style side-channel attacks.
findings.evidence: Header 'Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy' was not returned in HTTP 200 response.

findings.title: Web Server Version Disclosure
findings.description: The Server header discloses the underlying web server software and potentially version or OS details. Disclosed value: 'cloudflare'.
findings.remediation: Disable or sanitize the 'Server' header in server/framework configuration to prevent fingerprinting.
